claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet detects an object bounding box as a pair of keypoints, the top-left corner and the bottom-right corner, using a single convolutional neural network.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We propose CornerNet, a new approach to object detection where we detect an object bounding box as a pair of keypoints, the top-left corner and the bottom-right corner, using a single convolution neural network.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet eliminates the need for designing anchor boxes commonly used in prior single-stage detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: By detecting objects as paired keypoints, we eliminate the need for designing a set of anchor boxes commonly used in prior single-stage detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet introduces corner pooling, a new type of pooling layer that helps the network better localize corners.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we introduce corner pooling, a new type of pooling layer that helps the network better localize corners.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet achieves a 42.2% AP on MS COCO, outperforming all existing one-stage detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: CornerNet achieves a 42.2% AP on MS COCO, outperforming all existing one-stage detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Corner pooling is critical to the superior performance of CornerNet.
claims.evidence_quote_short: through ablation studies we show that corner pooling is critical to the superior performance of CornerNet.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The main bottleneck of CornerNet is detecting corners.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Using the ground-truth heatmaps alone improves the AP from 38.4% to 73.1%, suggesting that the main bottleneck of CornerNet is detecting corners.

claims.claim_text_normalized: CornerNet is able to generate bounding boxes of higher quality compared to other state-of-the-art detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: CornerNet is able to generate bounding boxes of higher quality compared to other state-of-the-art detectors.
